scope: FIT plus validation development only; no outer prediction, metric, or selection

source.VLOO: other 12 validation patients; Macro-F1, EZ-F1, BA, threshold closest 0.5, earlier epoch
source.R4: exact original classifier forward-pre-hook input D=64; original classifier replay <=1e-6
source.private_representation_reuse: The prior reference's selected-epoch private FIT/validation R4 payloads are reusable only after fresh 150-grid A1 replay and exact source/role/checkpoint/threshold provenance checks; no prior aggregate result is an implementation input

preprocess: one FIT-channel-row StandardScaler per selected fold/epoch; transform FIT and validation R4, no target labels
frozen_margin: m0=logit(VLOO NEZ threshold)-original NEZ logit; positive means EZ; zero budget exactly frozen A1

splits.seed: first 64 SHA256 bits of UTF-8 pipe-joined components modulo 2^32

calibrator.support_loss: mean binary cross entropy with logits, EZ positive + lambda_w * squared L2(delta_w) + 1.0 * delta_b^2
calibrator.optimizer: deterministic scipy L-BFGS-B with analytic gradient, maxiter=200, no A1 updates
calibrator.geometry_cosine: delta_w versus patient oracle direction transformed to FIT-standardized coordinates (raw oracle coefficient multiplied elementwise by FIT scaler scale)

fit_lambda_selection.base_margin: same frozen A1 checkpoint and target-cell VLOO threshold, applied to FIT patient logits
fit_lambda_selection.criterion: patient-equal mean query EZ-AP; ties within 1e-6 choose larger lambda
fit_lambda_selection.reuse: one selection per distinct fold/selected-epoch/VLOO-threshold triple

acquisition.RANDOM: fixed label-blind candidate permutation, first B
acquisition.UNCERTAINTY: sequential minimum absolute current calibrated margin, stable channel hash tie-break
acquisition.UNCERTAINTY_DIVERSITY: sequential 0.5 uncertainty percentile rank plus 0.5 nearest-support cosine-distance percentile rank in standardized R4; empty support diversity rank=1; stable channel hash tie-break
acquisition.ORACLE_BALANCED_RANDOM: B>=2 only; candidate labels used to make approximately class-balanced support; nondeployable and excluded from gates
acquisition.FULL_POOL_CALIBRATION: all candidate labels, same full residual, non-few-shot capacity bound

target_evaluation.query: same fixed query channels for all methods and budgets in a repetition
target_evaluation.one_class: AP/AUROC and positive-class ranking are nonestimable when either class absent; no redraw
target_evaluation.oracle: target-label-using inner cross-fitted LogisticRegression C=1 K=min(5,nEZ,nNEZ), diagnostic only after scores frozen

bootstrap.unit: unique patient ID, include all folds and repetitions

gates.fewshot: predeclared B<=8, one of RANDOM/UNCERTAINTY/UNCERTAINTY_DIVERSITY; all nine conditions in user protocol
gates.active: UNCERTAINTY_DIVERSITY versus RANDOM at B<=8; all six conditions in user protocol
gates.full_pool: AP gain>=0.030, positive >=4/5 folds, patient-cluster lower CI>0

outer_policy: No outer loader/prediction/metric or historical outer outcome; disclose legacy monolithic loader label materialization if unavoidable
public_outputs: code, lock, aggregate CSV/JSON/report only; no patient rows, labels, representations, checkpoints or logs
